mutants.why: the registry check compares the height a secret was shown at with the lock's deadline HEIGHT instead of its SECOND (deadline + slack): a reveal in the slack still counts on chain and the hub co-signs the expiry (PR 176 compares at <= deadline)
mutants.old: pure def regShows(s: St): bool = s.revealedAt != 0 and s.revealedAt <= TUX
mutants.new: pure def regShows(s: St): bool = s.revealedAt != 0 and s.revealedAt <= TU
